newsitem.title: USA: Alan Jackson wins top country music awards.
newsitem.headline: Alan Jackson wins top country music awards.

text.p: Alan Jackson won both "Male Artist of the Year" and "Entertainer of the Year" on Monday at the TNN/Music City News Country Awards Show telecast from the Grand Ole Opry over The Nashville Network (TNN).

A surprise winner was Billy Ray Cyrus who won "Single of the Year" with "Trail of Tears." Cyrus beat out 14-year-old LeAnn Rimes, whose sultry torch song, "Blue," topped the charts for months last year. But Rimes was an easy winner of "Star of Tomorrow-Female Artist" as well as an accomplished co-host on the show with Randy Travis and George Jones.

A highlight of the evening was the presentation by Loretta Lynn of the "Living Legend" award to Charley Pride, a major black country music artist. George Lindsey, who played "Goober" on the Andy Griffith TV series for years, won the "Minnie Pearl Award" for his contributions to the country music industry.
Lynn, whose autobiography, "Coal Miner's Daughter," was made into an award-winning film, is one of country music's best-known stars.

Making one of her rare appearances at the awards show since the death last year of her husband, she told reporters backstage she would like to be remembered by her fans not as a great singer but "as a good person that I hope has never hurt anyone, but if I have, I'm sorry and I'd rather be hurt myself than hurt another."

Other winners in the show, which kicks off Nashville's annual week-long "Fan Fair," when country music fans jam the Tennessee state fairgrounds for the chance to chat with their favourite stars, were:

Vocal Band of the Year: Sawyer Brown; Vocal Duo of the Year: Brooks & Dunn; Christian Country Artist: Ricky Van Shelton; Vocal Collaboration: "By My Side" -- Lorrie Morgan & Jon Randall; Video of the Year: "Then You Can Tell Me Goodbye" -- Neal McCoy; Comedian of the Year: Jeff Foxworthy; Vocal Group of the Year: Statler Brothers; Album of the Year: "Blue Clear Sky" -- George Strait; Star of Tomorrow - Male Artist: Wade Hayes; Female Artist of the Year: Lorrie Morgan.
